purpose: Bounded measured coverage of NAM architectures beyond the RT-002/RT-003 lstm.nam example, through the actual GuitarCompanionProcessor::processBlock.

architectures.role: A1 WaveNet, 10 dilations, 16/8 channels, no condition_dsp
A2-style WaveNet with condition_dsp, bottleneck and grouped/Softsign config

not_in_predeclared_set.my_model.nam: byte-identical to wavenet_a1_standard.nam (same sha256); not a distinct type
not_in_predeclared_set.slimmable_container.nam: container of LSTM + two WaveNets; not measured in this bounded set (5-type cap)
not_in_predeclared_set.wavenet_condition_dsp.nam: WaveNet with condition_dsp; not measured in this bounded set (5-type cap)
not_in_predeclared_set.wavenet.nam: small WaveNet v0.5.4; not measured in this bounded set (5-type cap)

repaired.description: existing processor_probe linked against RT-003 integration product archives (libnam_core.a patched, sha256 dbd11fb2...)

original_control.description: existing processor_probe linked against pinned upstream libnam_core_original.a (sha256 af023ffc...); control only, not the current processor

validity_rules: model must load (loaded=1 post-dry, error empty) and activation line must be present, else status is unmeasured (never clean)
missing model file, nonzero exit, malformed JSON/CSV, missing or duplicate cases, non-finite out_rms or process time, or sha/identity mismatch fail closed
allocations, frees, locks, trylock, cond and no-op frees are reported as findings and are never suppressed or used to change the expected matrix
per-sample output is not dumped by the existing probe; only the mean warm out_rms is checked for finiteness
